name: Tactical Dungeon Slayers
description:
About This Game

About this Game

Slay the Spire-style roguelite deckbuilding meets high-mobility tactical combat and terrain strategy. Find the perfect position to unleash powerful deck combos and AoE attacks, wiping out enemies while avoiding the enemy’s kill zones.

Key Features

  • Every card is a compound tactical command. Adjust your position, attack enemies, knock them back, deal area damage, and trigger a variety of status effects, all in a single play.

  • High mobility. Move farther and more freely than in traditional grid-based tactics games, with a wide range of satisfying movement abilities.

  • Devastating AoE Combos. Build powerful combos, wipe out groups of enemies, and clear the battlefield in spectacular fashion.

  • Deeper tactical decision-making. Position yourself carefully, exploit the terrain, and unleash your deck’s strongest combos from the perfect spot, while avoiding dangerous areas.

  • Anticipate enemy actions, use terrain and positioning to your advantage, and deliver devastating counterattacks.

  • Rewind individual actions or entire turns to explore different tactical possibilities.

Roguelite Content

  • Randomized combat encounters with branching choices.

  • A rich pool of cards, equipment, and items. Build a unique tactical deck by combining randomized rewards and options.

  • Unlock more cards, equipment, and gameplay content after completing a run or falling in battle. Every new run offers a different combat experience.

    • The demo features limited unlockable content. The full experience will be available in the final release.

  • Unlock higher difficulty challenges and brand-new chapters after completing the game.

    • This feature is available in the full release and is not included in this demo.
